description: Start one successor of a terminal single-candidate Agent or Ask run on the existing daemon. The daemon inherits only mode, scope, execution, harness and model; every other omitted control takes its ordinary new-run default, not the predecessor's value, so restate access, web, account, budget, time limit and review when the successor must keep them. Budget and time limits apply to this successor alone, never as a remainder of the chain. prompt is optional and may be empty. Supply idempotencyKey to replay an unknown response. Returns the same durable handle as the launch tools (jobId, runId once bound); pass either as runId to claudexor_run_wait/status/result.
